seo.title: About SoulSync Global
seo.description: Our goal, mission, policies, and team behind a privacy-first, faith-aware matrimony platform built for respectful connections.

hero.title: About SoulSync Global
hero.subtitle: We combine thoughtful technology with community guidelines so families can discover marriage prospects with dignity, transparency, and control.

goal.title: Our goal
goal.body: Help serious adults find a compatible life partner within faith traditions and community norms—without sacrificing privacy or family involvement. SoulSync Global makes discovery structured, consent-based, and easier to navigate for both members and guardians.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Build a multi-tenant matrimony marketplace where each community sets supported traditions and policies, profiles earn trust through review, and every connection step respects visibility choices. We invest in clear workflows—from biodata completeness to guardian contact—so technology serves values, not the other way around.

coreValues.title: Our Core Values
coreValues.description: Principles that guide product decisions, community partnerships, and how we treat member data.

items.title: Dignity in discovery
items.body: Marriage search should feel respectful—profiles, messaging norms, and community rules are designed to honor members and families.

items.title: Consent first
items.body: Visibility, interest, and contact sharing stay under member control with clear mutual steps—not open-by-default exposure.

items.title: Faith-aware communities
items.body: Each tenant sets supported traditions and discovery rules so search happens within norms members already trust.

items.title: Family involvement
items.body: Guardian contacts, managed profiles, and editor grants keep families included without bypassing member consent.

items.title: Integrity
items.body: We document marriage confirmations and registry history with clear statuses—no hidden state changes or opaque workflows.

items.title: Privacy by design
items.body: Sensitive fields are protected, public views are minimized, and activity is logged for accountability—not resale.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.description: SoulSync Global connects structured biodata, community governance, and secure tooling for serious marriage search.

items.title: Biodata & discovery
items.body: Rich, section-based profiles with partner preferences, visibility controls, and community-scoped search that respects tenant rules.

items.title: Multi-tenant communities
items.body: Independent faith and cultural communities on one platform—each with moderators, supported religions, and localized policies.

items.title: Guardian workflows
items.body: Structured guardian contact, permission requests, and family-managed biodata so the right people stay in the loop.

items.title: Marriage registry & confirmation
items.body: Private registry history plus mutual SoulSync confirmations—synced where linked—for transparent public marriage dates when members choose.

achievements.title: Our Achievements & Milestones
achievements.description: Key steps in building a trustworthy, theme-aware platform for faith-aware matrimony.

items.title: Marriage registry & public family summary
items.body: Shipped private marriage history, SoulSync confirmations, and respectful public biodata family summaries.

items.title: Member experience polish
items.body: Expanded multi-theme support, activity transparency, and marketing pages—including this About experience.

items.title: Multi-tenant communities live
items.body: Onboarded active tenant communities with religion-aware discovery settings and group features.

items.title: Field-level encryption
items.body: Rolled out encrypted storage for sensitive biodata and marriage registry contact fields at rest.

items.title: Platform foundation
items.body: Launched core biodata, auth, and community membership flows with moderation-first discoverability.

policies.title: Data security & privacy
policies.body: Sensitive biodata and registry fields are encrypted at rest. Access is limited to authenticated flows you approve—public views show only what your visibility settings allow. We minimize data retention, audit high-risk actions, and design features so PII is never exposed by default in feeds or listings.

policies.title: Consent & visibility
policies.body: You choose who can see your profile, when to express interest, and how guardian or family contacts are shared. Connection flows require mutual steps rather than open messaging by default.

policies.title: Community standards
policies.body: Each tenant defines supported faiths, moderation rules, and discovery criteria. Moderators review submissions before profiles become broadly discoverable, reducing misuse while keeping processes transparent to members.

policies.title: Integrity & accountability
policies.body: We treat marriage confirmation and registry data as long-lived records with clear status rules. Platform activity is logged for security and support—never sold to third-party advertisers.

trustPillars.title: Review before discovery
trustPillars.body: Profiles move through community review so discoverability reflects tenant rules—not anonymous uploads.

trustPillars.title: Guardian-aware workflows
trustPillars.body: Family and guardian contacts stay structured in biodata, with permissions for managed profiles and editor grants.

trustPillars.title: Tenant-specific policies
trustPillars.body: Supported traditions, partner preferences, and local norms are configured per community rather than one global template.

trustPillars.title: Transparent next steps
trustPillars.body: Interest, acceptance, and marriage confirmation flows show clear status—members always know where a connection stands.
